song: 02 - Sean Paul - I'm Still In Love With You (Official Video)
title: stained glass lit by the riddim, then the panes go out
story: Sean Paul's lovers-rock riddim (86 BPM tracker, the accents sit on beats 1 and 3 and the rims on 2 and 4) plays over a stained-glass window of big pale panes with a thin lead and a warm glow. Each strong beat-1/3 hit bulges the window and lifts its light, each rim on 2 and 4 deepens the glass, and one pane-light step lands on every bar. At the break (8216) the riddim falls away and the panes go out one per bar; the two biggest isolated hits (8435, 8524) light the window hard with a shake and a new colour centre each, and the window settles into a low warm glow until the music is silent.
